metadata.title: A planar program for the two-variable Jacobian conjecture: a theorem ladder, staircase transport, and machine certificates at the (72,108) frontier
metadata.description:
Paper B of a three-paper research record. The two-variable Jacobian conjecture remains open after the 2026 counterexample in dimension 3. This paper develops the planar program and an exact-arithmetic campaign on the lone open degree pair (72,108) below 125, built on Guccione-Guccione-Horruitiner-Valqui (arXiv:2204.14178, Proposition 4.3). Version 0.21 retains the exact three-coefficient chart cover and full-family rank/core audit, then advances the weighted residual. On d not equal to zero, three irreducible selected-factor components each admit an alternative full-rank minor generically. On d=0, cancellation of the forced x term makes P itself an admissible Q and exposes the exact kernel [P,P]=0. Removing its fixed y^8 coordinate gives a 302-by-124 quotient augmented system. One exact quotient determinant factors as a nonzero scalar times b^32, one five-term weighted factor, and five binomials. On b not equal to zero, z=a^3/b^7 reduces the residual to nine distinct invariant points: five rational and four roots of a squarefree quartic. Alternative quotient charts are still required on those points and b=0. The work does not close the 24-parameter core, full (72,108), or JC(2).

All scripts, artifacts and verdicts: https://github.com/fsantibanezleal/CAOS_RESEARCH (problems/algebraic-geometry/jacobian-conjecture).
